_comment: Proof-without-words diagrams (Zone 9, proof.words.match). The picture is drawn in code (PatternArt, visual type 'proof'); the answer of a problem is a diagram id and its button reads label_line_id. 'explains' is for grown-ups and the math reviewer (never shown to the child). n is the picture's size.

diagrams.explains: Two staircases of 1 + 2 + ... + n gems fit into an n by (n + 1) rectangle, so the sum is half of n x (n + 1) (Gauss's sum).
The staircases of n rows and n - 1 rows fit into an n by n square: T(n) + T(n - 1) = n x n.
L-shaped layers of 1, 3, 5, ... gems stack into a square: the first n odd numbers add up to n x n.
An n by (n + 2) array turned a quarter turn is an (n + 2) by n array with the same gems: a x b = b x a.
Squares whose sides are the first n Fibonacci numbers fit together into a rectangle of F(n) by F(n + 1).
